preregistration_note: Protocol frozen before evaluation residuals were inspected for scoring claims. Prototype unit checks used a single spectrum only to verify SI conversion.

observable.name: photon_surface_radiance_365_650_nm
observable.convention: ground-level surface radiance; energy spectra converted with I_ph = I_E * lambda / (h c). Lower bound 365 nm admits all G300V+FREE library starts (CRVAL1<=3640.5 A) while remaining inside NSB's 300-650 nm domain.
observable.rejected_alternative_361p5_nm: A 361.5 nm cut rejects most FREE spectra whose tabulated start lies between 3615 and 3641 A despite covering the science band.

dataset.identity: Patat 2008 FORS1 Night Sky Spectral Library

site.identity: Cerro Paranal nominal; FORS1 archive spectra

selection.rationale: Moonless dark-time G300V open spectra fully covering 3615-6500 A; |b|>=20 reduces bright-star slit contamination; moon below horizon forces moonlight=0 for both models.

components.airglow: integrate_band_components 365-650 nm; PALACE continuum only (lines excluded)
components.starlight: production 300-650 nm map scaled by independent solar-photon band fraction f_band

starlight_band_fraction.method: photon integral of Rieke 2008 solar spectrum
starlight_band_fraction.rationale: Independent SED shape proxy for redistributing the production integrated Starlight map into the observation band; not fitted to evaluation residuals.

components.zodiacal: from_leinert1998 source radiance through 365-650 nm top-hat; no additional extinction in native path
components.airglow: from_eso_skycalc(90 km, observation SUNFLUX); includes lines
components.starlight: from_gaia_dr3_map faint HEALPix (G>=15) diffuse ISL; bright catalog excluded to match slit sky extraction

statistics.baseline: per-campaign median radiance fitted on calibration nights only

known_limitations: NSB airglow continuum omits emission lines present in the spectra
NSB Starlight uses an independent solar-photon band-fraction proxy
NSB production Starlight map includes bright-star light averaged into HEALPix pixels; slit spectra reject discrete bright contaminants
nsb2 native path is source-level surface radiance without the IACT instrument response
Patat flux calibration uses a reference sensitivity function without mirror-oxidation time dependence (few-percent level)
No per-spectrum statistical uncertainty is published; calibration_fractional_sigma=0.05 is adopted from Patat's stated few-percent sensitivity variation
